llm_response.reason: The website claims to be an official Acne Studios Outlet despite the domain ('specialized-gb.com') being unrelated to the brand. The entire site content is cloned from or heavily references 'acnestudios.co.at,' and nearly all hyperlinks redirect to another suspicious, non-official site. Classic scam features are present: free shipping/returns offers, mismatched or spoofed branding, and an ambiguous business identity. These align with well-known Fake Online Shopping scam patterns.
